method: Paired independent battles, 45/95 floors, same seeds before/after. Primary: eight teams ×16 seeds ×2 floors =256 per NPC, DamagePolicy. Holdout: eight different teams ×8 new seeds ×2 floors =128 per NPC, TowerPolicy. Extra adaptive-player check: holdout teams ×4 new seeds ×2 floors =64 per NPC, LearningOpponentPolicy(p1). Player has curated defaults, 31 IV, 66 normal points, no held items; NPC retains existing 48/66 budgets, named IV distribution, Tactical/Expert and gimmick gates. Not human win rates.
